messages:
Ava (oncall): Noticed a sustained throughput drop for the realtime endpoint during the 01:00 UTC nightly batch overlap. p99 latency climbed and throughput dipped for ~12m. Opening thread to decide temporary SLO handling + owners.

Ben: Saw it too. Two scheduled batch jobs started at the same time and saturated the network attachment on the ingress nodes. Happens sporadically when deployments align with batches.

Rina: Can we avoid changing SLOs by rescheduling batch windows? Short-term we might also move noncritical batches to the staging region.

Ava (oncall): Quick metrics: p99 from 220ms -> 1.1s, throughput -18%. Dashboard: https://redwood.dev/dash/realtime/batch-overlap-01

Theo: Suggest short-term mitigation: move the nightly heavy batch back by 30m and set a temporary p99 target of 1.2s for 24h while we implement node-level network isolation. Owner proposals: Theo -> node isolation, Rina -> schedule change, Ben -> SLO comms.

Rina: I can shift the noncritical batch to 01:30 UTC for the next 3 nights. ETA: 1h to update scheduler entries and notify owners.

Ben: I'll post the SLO change + status note. Proposal: p99 500ms -> 1.2s for 24h and mark as "operational maintenance" to exclude from monthly burn. ETA: 45m.

Theo: I'll start the node isolation play (network qos + dedicating ENIs). Can test in canary tonight. ETA: 48h for rollout.

Ava (oncall): Ops-Bot, create a parent ticket and subtasks for scheduler edit, SLO comms, network isolation, and dashboard panel for batch overlap.

Ops-Bot: Created ticket REDW-3612 and subtasks REDW-3613 (reschedule batches) -> Rina, REDW-3614 (SLO update & comms) -> Ben, REDW-3615 (network isolation) -> Theo, REDW-3616 (dashboard panel) -> Ava. Due dates assigned.

Rina: Scheduler updated in canary; will apply to prod after 2 successful canary runs.

Ben: Status page posted and SLO dashboard annotated: https://status.redwood.dev/incidents/REDW-3612

Ava (oncall): Scheduling 24h check-in: 2823542989. Please update tickets as progress is made; I'll link this to the postmortem afterward.

Ops-Bot: Reminder scheduled: 2823542989 - "24h check-in: batch-overlap SLO review"
